description: This file defines a TypeScript class 'Users' for managing user management UI components in the Mattermost system console, including locators, modals, menus, and actions related to user management.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: A class representing the user management section in the system console, encapsulating locators, modals, menus, and actions for user management.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Waits for the user management container and header to be visible.

methods.name: isLoadingComplete
methods.description: Waits for the loading spinner to disappear, indicating loading is complete.

methods.name: searchUsers
methods.description: Fills the search input with a search term and waits for loading to complete.

methods.name: getFilterCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active filters from the filters button text.

methods.name: openColumnToggleMenu
methods.description: Opens the column toggle menu and returns its instance.

methods.name: openFilterPopover
methods.description: Opens the filter popover and returns its instance.

methods.name: openDateRangeSelectorMenu
methods.description: Opens the date range selector menu and returns its instance.

methods.name: goToNextPage
methods.description: Navigates to the next page of users.

methods.name: goToPreviousPage
methods.description: Navigates to the previous page of users.

methods.name: getTotalUserCount
methods.description: Extracts and returns the total number of users from pagination info.
